newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to higher levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. Eight barges on southbound barge freight options were traded versus none on Tuesday, Exchange sources said.

- Eight barges, two each week of October, 1997, call options, Mid-Mississippi River, strike price at 250 percent net 10 days, traded at 10 percent of tariff, with Peavey selling to Consolidated Grain and Barge, sources said.
- Two barges, this week, St Paul-Savage (Upper Mississippi) no bid, offer 255 percent. No comparison.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, bid 195 percent, offer 210 percent, up five percentage points from similar offer Tuesday.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 210 percent, offer 215 percent. No comparison with Tuesday.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, bid 175 percent, up five percentage points, offer 180 percent, unchanged.
